state.description:
Current state of this execution:
 * `PREVIEW` - Execution has not been started and may be reviewed before doing so
 * `IN_PROGRESS` - Execution is currently running
 * `COMPLETED` - Execution has finished, with all requested steps successfully completed
 * `FAILED` - Execution has finished, with one or more requested steps failing
 * `EXPECTED_FAILURE` - Execution has finished, with one or more requested steps satisfied certain conditions and
    expected to fail

steps.description:
The sequence of steps that will be performed by this execution. Steps are provided in a logical order, though they may be
executed in parallel by the underlying system. If the execution is in progress or finished then each step can be inspected to
find its state.

QuickActionsError.description: Provides error details for non-2xx response

errorMessage.description: Detailed information about the error that occurred.

requestId.description: A unique value generated by the server to identify the request.

optional.description: Set to `true` if this step is optional and can be deselected when starting execution.

state.description:
Current state of this step:
 * `PENDING` - Step has not been started but is ready for execution
 * `IN_PROGRESS` - Step is currently running
 * `COMPLETED` - Step has finished successfully
 * `FAILED` - Step has finished unsuccessfully; the `errorMessage` property will be set with an explanation
 * `OMITTED` - An optional step has been omitted as it was not selected when the execution was started
 * `ABANDONED` - Step has not been started and never will be as the execution has failed

post.description:
Creates an execution for an action, which may be created in a `PREVIEW` (unstarted) state at the discretion of the caller.
If the caller sets `preview` to `false` (the default) then the execution will immediately be started with all optional steps included. The caller may call `getExecution` to check the progress of the execution.
If the caller sets `preview` to `true` then they can inspect the Steps within the execution to review whether they are happy to proceed with it and, if so, invoke `startExecution` to do so. If the caller does not want to proceed then the execution may simply be left alone: there is no need to take further action and the execution will remain unstarted. Multiple preview executions may exist for a given action but only one non-preview; if one already exists then the caller will be redirected to that. This enables multiple potential callers to construct and review a preview even though only one may be started. Note that the content of preview executions for a given action may vary if the state of other resources (e.g. orders, line items) has changed, but the caller has a guarantee that if they execute a preview then only the steps provided in it will be executed.

**Authorized resource type**:
DSP Rodeo Entity ID, DSP Advertiser Account ID

**Parameter name**:
Amazon-Ads-AccountId

**Parameter in**:
header

**Requires one of these permissions**:
["campaign_edit"]
